science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
insight_text: The Hearth radiated an oppressive, dry heat that caught in the throat, carrying the sharp scent of roasted tubers and oxidized iron. Ryn gripped the heavy brass ladle, her knuckles white, wiping a sheen of sweat from her brow as she peered into the simmering cauldron of myco-proteins. She had to DEFEND the delicate amino-acid balance against the sudden temperature drops caused by the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea. Carefully, she adjusted the induction plates to ATTRACT the ambient thermal energy, stabilizing the boil. She knew she had to CONSUME every ounce of her concentration; the immediate risk was a ruined batch of nutrient broth, but the deeper consequence was a compromised caloric margin that could leave the entire colony shivering through the next shift. At the core, ensuring The Feast was mathematically perfect was her way of holding the Enclave's fragile survival together against the void. Satisfied with the rolling boil, Ryn grabbed the warm, sauce-stained tasting spoon and shoved it directly into Silas's hand.
summary: Ryn manages the delicate thermal balance of the nutrient broth against the disruptions of the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear, handing her tasting spoon to Silas.
